"Osteoarthritis (OA), particularly post-traumatic OA (PTOA) affecting 10% of knee OA cases, involves trauma-induced chondrocyte death, synovial inflammation, and cartilage degradation via MMPs/ADAMTS enzymes. The hexosamine biosynthetic pathway (HBP) produces UDP-GlcNAc, essential for glycosaminoglycan (GAG) synthesis in cartilage.
